title: Procedural Preview All Types
description: Extend procedural preview pipeline so point and vector outputs are rendered alongside geometry (curves, surfaces, solids). Unify into ProceduralPreviewItem model.
summary: Fixed procedural 2D and 3D nested-list previews and the concrete BRep face extraction path. The BRep kernel now deconstructs solids into retained vertex, edge, and face handles; flow retains both topology and drawing handles; worker meshes are keyed by handle identity; 2D/3D extractors traverse arrays; and Hexagonal Mushroom Column connects BRep.face to list.get. Also repaired procedural split fallout in fixture paths, renderer app/flow imports, and the 3D play Vitest aliases. Verified with 68 flow-core tests, 11 BRep module tests, procedural 3D React 12 tests, procedural 3D Play 47 tests, procedural 2D React 4 tests, procedural 2D Play 30 tests, the registered hexagonal production build, and a live browser run selecting list_get_4.out.0 with a clean console.
